name: learning-coach
description: Learn, view, and maintain a private GitHub-backed learning state with auditable mastery evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Learn, inspect, and maintain a private knowledge tree
interface.longDescription: Learn through practice with auditable mastery evidence, inspect current progress through read-only Learning View, and periodically review or refactor a private GitHub-backed Learning Vault.
defaultPrompt: Help me master agent memory and resume from my Learning Vault.
Show my current learning state without changing my Learning Vault.
Show the roadmap and stored evidence for my current Topic.
Review my Learning Vault for structural issues and propose safe refactors.
